name: git-statusline
description: A mod that draws a git line under the prompt: repo path, branch, linked-worktree marker, ahead/behind with colour past unpushed-commit thresholds, staged/modified/new/conflict counts, changed lines and stash count.

enabled.title: Enable the mod
enabled.description: Off removes the git line under the prompt. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session. Only an exact false turns it off.

push_warning_threshold.title: Unpushed commits: warning
push_warning_threshold.description: Colour the ahead count amber at this many unpushed commits. 0 turns it off.

push_critical_threshold.title: Unpushed commits: critical
push_critical_threshold.description: Colour the ahead count red at this many unpushed commits. 0 turns it off.

show_changed_lines.title: Show changed lines
show_changed_lines.description: Off skips git diff HEAD --numstat and leaves the added and deleted line counts off the line. Only an exact false turns it off.

show_stashes.title: Show stash count
show_stashes.description: Off skips git stash list and leaves the stash count off the line. Only an exact false turns it off.

git_timeout_seconds.title: Git timeout (seconds)
git_timeout_seconds.description: How long each git call may run before it is abandoned. Values outside 1 to 60 are clamped; anything unreadable uses 10.
